set.st: $19 in silver found by Patrick Dillon in his garden on the former Kearney homestead at Pinckney, May 1932. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself. Found: in May 1932 a man gardening on a former homestead at Pinckney dug up an old tin can holding $19 in silver (wire reports said about $20), and nothing more was said to remain.
pinev: Placed from the source text: GNIS Pinckney (village)
1930 census: Patrick Dillon b. 1884 IN, Pinckney, a son b. 1917 New York, so the family came after 1917; no Dillon on the 1915 Putnam Twp plate. Farm not placed.
1932 local paper: the farm was formerly the Kearney homestead, so the 1915 Putnam Twp plate can place it under Kearney (queued).

src: Livingston County Press & Argus, 4 May 1932, p. 5 (Newspapers.com 453732248)
